authorInfo.bio:
John Lawson (1674–1711) wrote A New Voyage to Carolina
Containing the exact description and natural history of that country; together with the present state thereof; and a journal of a thousand miles, travel'd thro' several nations of Indians; giving a particular account of their customs, manners, etc.. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
